question: How do I specify which model to use when calling the speech-to-speech API endpoint?
ground_truth: For speech-to-speech voice conversion, specify the model using the model_id parameter in your multipart form data request. The parameter defaults to 'eleven_english_sts_v2'. An example model ID is 'eleven_multilingual_sts_v2'. You can get a list of all available models by calling the GET /v1/models endpoint, which returns model information including the can_do_voice_conversion boolean field indicating whether the model supports voice conversion.

correctness: May mention eleven_multilingual_sts_v2 as an example
